notes.title: LIfe Update
notes.content:
Hello Hunters!

I wanted to give you an update on how things are going with the game. Being the sole developer is hard and you're not always in the right headspace. I have had a busy and rough semester in college; on top of that, I was hit with a huge bought of depression. Along with trying to find a way to support myself through all of it.
I have not abandoned this. I just hit a wall and slowed down. I was going so fast and hard.

~Varcyon~
